This map had a unique system of giving players cash for killing or damaging enemies. You only got cash from them if they were killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount you got was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. In solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed or you damaged it enough. With each additional player, this decreased by 25%, which means that in a trio, you only got 50% of the cash. This amount was distributed between players based on how much damage they dealt. However, if a player did not deal any damage, they would receive a percentage of the enemy's full cash upon its death or when it was damaged enough, which was 12.5% in duo and 16.7% in trio. For both stages, the map was set in a large purple and yellow colored theater. Multiple lights and chandeliers could be seen on the walls or on the ceiling. It had multiple seats that were empty. The actual map took place in the middle of the theater, being separated from the audience by a large gap, with only small ropes with lines connecting them.
The first stage was similar to

. The path started from a cave, immediately going down into a broken down stone gate-arch, which immediately crossed over onto a wood footbridge over a bright green lake. The path proceeded onto a stone walkway, making several short turns roughly in a circle, intersecting various lampposts and carnival tents. The path again crossed over the lake, approximating another wide circle, intersecting various lampposts, trees and tents. A tall orange tower could be found at the back of the map. Various dead trees, pumpkins, carnival banners and hills could have been found scattered over the map.
The second stage was similar to

. In the center of the map was a large hill with a statue in the center of it which provided valuable cliff space. The path began at a similar broken down stone gate-arch. The path had changed, with a small turn beginning the path before immediately doubling back to a longer stretch, circling around the center statue and another hill before making a few final turns to the exit. Various lampposts could be found around corners, with fallen trees and rocks decorating the landscape. A large cottage was found near the rear half of the map, and various hills and rockfaces stood out across the path. Various village houses and even a burial house could be found towards the side of the map, with the path terminating at a large communal structure.
